functions.name: apply_encumbrance
functions.doc:
Section 3 is enforced here, when the freeze lands: a signature raced in between the
 registry call and this receipt makes the listing or pledge fail. Ends any transit.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: begin_transit
functions.doc:
First step of a settlement. From here until `apply_encumbrance` names the final holder, no
 account has shareholder or agent rights, so a settlement that fails midway hands nothing to
 anyone. Refuses dirty keys and unexpired intents the same way a freeze does.

functions.name: ft_on_transfer
functions.doc: NEP-141 receiver. The only path that books revenue.

functions.name: on_intents_deposit
functions.doc: `ft_transfer_call` returns the amount the receiver kept.

functions.name: pay_compute_bill
functions.doc:
Allowed while encumbered: a listed or pledged company keeps paying its compute bills, and
 the funds can only reach the `compute_payee` fixed at incorporation.

functions.name: refresh_metrics
functions.doc:
Pushes current metrics to the registry. The registry keeps a snapshot and cannot read the
 vault's 30-day window on its own, so a quiet company's charter goes stale until this runs.

functions.name: request_shareholder_signature
functions.doc:
Marks the current epoch dirty before calling the signer, so the company cannot be listed or
 pledged until the shareholder rotates to fresh addresses.

functions.name: setup_intents_key
functions.doc: Takes no key argument. Only the MPC-derived key for the intents path is ever registered.

functions.name: sign_legacy_epoch
functions.doc:
Reaches funds left on addresses from a previous epoch. Those funds are excluded from NAV,
 and these signatures do not dirty the current epoch.

functions.name: swap_tee_request
functions.doc: The exact request body for an `agent_swap_intent` approval. Hash it as sent.

functions.name: sync_owner
functions.doc:
A direct change of shareholder, used by `nft_transfer`. `require_clean` is set when an
 approved account moves the token, which is how a marketplace sells it: raw signatures in
 the current epoch then refuse the sale. Without it, a dirty epoch rotates in
 `set_shareholder`, and the receiver starts on keys that have never signed.

Policy.description: Agent-facing configuration. A new shareholder starts from the values fixed at incorporation, so a seller cannot hand a buyer an operator or TEE signer of their own choosing.

price_floors.description: A pair with no floor cannot be swapped.

tee_models.description: Model ids an approval may come from. An empty list refuses every approval.

tee_prompt_hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the system prompt. Empty refuses every approval.

PriceFloor.description: A swap of `sell_token` for `buy_token` must promise at least `min_buy` buy units for every `per_sell` sell units, in base units. A shareholder-set bound, not an oracle price.

SignedIntent.description: Ready for `execute_intents` or the solver relay.

TeeRequest.description: The exact bytes the operator must send to NEAR AI for a proposal, and the hash the model must answer with.
